column1: Electricity day-ahead dataset, Germany/Luxembourg, 1 Oct 2024 - 30 Sep 2026

column2: SMARD (Bundesnetzagentur): day-ahead prices, DA forecast consumption, DA forecast generation
Volumes converted from MWh per quarter-hour to average GW (x4 / 1000). Prices in EUR/MWh.
SMARD timestamps are German local time. start_utc is unique; use it for ordering. Hourly groups are built on UTC hours, so the repeated autumn hour stays separate.
post = 1 from delivery date 1 Oct 2025. Before that, the 4 quarter-hour prices in an hour are identical (hourly auction).
17,520 hours. Use for Question 1: price_de on rl_fc_gw and rl_post with date and hour fixed effects.
70,080 quarter-hours. Use for Question 2 (keep post==1): price_dev on rl_dev.
beta1 = 3.71, beta2 = +0.01 (p = 0.94), SE clustered by date. Paper: 3.76 and -0.094 (p = 0.53).
beta = 8.90, R2 = 0.521, n = 35,040. Matches paper. SE = 0.046 (OLS) / 0.16 (clustered by date); paper 0.16.
